name: Upstairs by Tom Shepherd
lunchNote: Same seven-course tasting menu at lunch, Wed–Sat

menus.name: signature seven-course tasting menu
menus.note: Discovery wine pairing £90, Classic £130, Iconic £175; 0% drinks pairing £58; vegetarian and pescatarian versions cost slightly less

menus.name: signature seven-course tasting menu at lunch
menus.note: Lunch Wednesday to Saturday; same pairings as at dinner

bookingOpens: Online only, on OpenTable. The diary is open to the end of August 2027; after that each month opens on the 1st of the month eleven months before (September 2027 opens on 1 October).
cancellation: A £35 deposit per person is taken when booking and comes off the bill. Cancel more than three days ahead for a refund (less a 75p fee per person); cancellations, fewer guests or no-shows within three days lose the deposit.
groups: Tables for up to six. The whole restaurant can be hired for up to 40 guests (info@upstairs.restaurant).
dressCode: Smart casual is suggested, but jeans and a T-shirt are fine.
children: Children are welcome but have the tasting menu at full price. Babies and toddlers can't be accommodated.
